summary: Retested iter-38 row-switching fix on /admin/market/evidence. Backdrop was split (right:720px) but it still sits ON TOP of the table area (z-40, no pointer-events:none). Rows in the left area cannot be clicked to switch records — every click in the leftward viewport is intercepted by the backdrop and closes the inspector. Regression checks (Backdrop close, ESC, X, all groups/fields testids, source-url anchor target=_blank, raw toggle/body) all still pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Row-switching WITHOUT closing is still BROKEN. The backdrop element (data-testid=record-inspector-backdrop) is fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-40 with right:720px and has an onClick={onClose}. It covers the entire left viewport ABOVE the <table>. document.elementFromPoint at x=50/300/500/700/850,y=428 always returns the backdrop div — so any click on a visible row in the leftward area hits the backdrop first and closes the inspector instead of switching records. Verified: opened row A (title 'House · Boroko'), attempted to click row 2 (bbox x=297..1559, well within left area); Playwright reported 'record-inspector subtree intercepts pointer events' and after force navigation the inspector stayed on the same record. This is the exact defect flagged in iter-38 — the split-backdrop approach does not solve it because the backdrop is still layered above the rows.

action_items: Make the backdrop non-interactive for pointer events so table rows in the left area are directly clickable — e.g., add `pointer-events-none` (Tailwind) to the backdrop and move the outside-click detection onto document/window with a mousedown listener that ignores clicks inside [data-testid='record-inspector']. Alternatively raise the table rows above the backdrop (position:relative + z-50) and drop the backdrop click-to-close behaviour, keeping ESC and X as closers.

After the fix, re-verify: (a) clicking a different row while inspector is open swaps `inspector-title` without closing, (b) clicking on empty backdrop area (or outside inspector) still closes (if intended), (c) ESC + X still close, (d) all iter-38 regression testids remain.
critical_code_review_comments: Evidence.jsx line ~185: backdrop is z-40 above the table (which has no explicit z-index). Splitting the backdrop horizontally does not enable click-through — CSS still routes clicks to the topmost element at that point. Use pointer-events:none on the backdrop, or restructure so rows sit above the backdrop layer.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing 100 seeded evidence rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest just the row-switching flow on /admin/market/evidence at viewport >=1400px. Open row A, click a different row (row 2/3) at x<=800; verify inspector stays open AND inspector-title changes. Regression: iter-38 field/group testids continue to pass in iter-39, no need to re-exhaust them unless RecordInspector is restructured significantly.
rca_of_the_issue: The 'split backdrop' fix only masks the panel column geometrically — it does not change stacking. The backdrop <div> is still positioned above the <table> with a click handler that calls onClose. Browsers hit-test the topmost element at the click point, so row clicks in the leftward region trigger the backdrop's onClick and never reach the row. Fix requires either pointer-events:none on the backdrop with a document-level outside-click listener, or elevating each <tr> above the backdrop's stacking context.
